groups.name: SIZ Football Academy
groups.summary: A structured youth football, league competition, academic mentorship, and environmental stewardship programme operating within the ENGANDA network in Entebbe.
groups.projectName: Plant a Tree, Plant a Player & Youth League Development
groups.projectDescription: Combines competitive youth football academies, the SIZ Football Gala, player development tracking, and the "Plant a Tree, Plant a Player" / "Sponsor a Tree" environmental stewardship initiative across Entebbe schools and pitches.
groups.supportFocus: Youth athlete bursaries, league pitch equipment, grassroots tournament sponsorship, and community tree-planting stewardship.
activities: Elite & Grassroots Youth Football Training Clinics (U-10 to U-17)
SIZ Football Gala & Inter-Community Youth League Competitions
Academic Bursaries, Life-Skills Mentorship & Player Welfare Tracking
Environmental Stewardship: "Sponsor a Tree" & "Plant a Tree, Plant a Player"

sponsorshipPackages.name: Eco-Captain
sponsorshipPackages.description: Headline programme & league sponsorship supporting full-season youth academy operations, tournament kits, player bursaries, and community environmental drives.

sponsorshipPackages.name: Playmaker
sponsorshipPackages.description: Co-sponsors regional youth league fixtures, coaching equipment, medical first-aid kits, and structured athlete mentorship cohorts.

sponsorshipPackages.name: Green Striker
sponsorshipPackages.description: Backs "Plant a Tree, Plant a Player" matchday environmental action, match balls, training bibs, and youth player nutrition.

sponsorshipPackages.name: Grassroots In-Kind
sponsorshipPackages.description: In-kind contribution of football boots, training gear, transport logistics, medical support, or educational materials.

groups.name: LeoLeo
groups.summary: A distinct community innovation, enterprise coordination, and youth skills mobilization programme operating within the ENGANDA network.
groups.projectDescription: Connects young creatives, local service providers, and community micro-enterprises to structured operational workflows, digital visibility, and market linkages.
groups.supportFocus: Enterprise incubation tooling, vocational mentorship partnerships, and community market-access initiatives.
activities: Youth Livelihood Skills & Service Readiness Coordination

groups.name: EGYA Association
groups.summary: A distinct youth and community association in Entebbe organizing 51 registered members around collective savings, vocational livelihoods, and peer accountability.
groups.projectDescription: Structured member savings governance, vocational trade coordination, and formal enterprise readiness for 51 active youth and community members in Entebbe.
groups.supportFocus: Working capital co-investment, vocational equipment access, and group governance training.
activities: Weekly Member Savings & Internal Credit Administration

groups.name: Abayita Ababiri Ghetto Group
groups.summary: Community youth group in Abayita Ababiri uniting 53 informal sector workers into a structured savings and livelihood unit.
groups.projectDescription: Organizes young technicians, market vendors, and transport workers in Abayita Ababiri into a disciplined savings and shared-tooling collective.
groups.supportFocus: Shared technical toolkits, financial literacy, and micro-enterprise credit readiness.

groups.name: Baghdad Association Group
groups.summary: Urban youth association in Entebbe bringing together 36 members for structured group savings, trade skills, and community welfare.
groups.projectDescription: Supports informal youth transition into documented commercial trades through collective savings discipline and peer-backed micro-loans.
groups.supportFocus: Vocational apprenticeships, trade licensing support, and group capital growth.

groups.name: BEP Auto Garage Savings
groups.summary: Specialized occupational savings group of 32 automotive mechanics, panel beaters, and garage technicians in Entebbe.
groups.projectName: BEP Shared Diagnostic & Garage Equipment Pool
groups.projectDescription: Pools daily workshop earnings from 32 mechanics to acquire modern vehicle diagnostic tools, compressors, and spare-parts inventory.
groups.supportFocus: Automotive diagnostic equipment, workshop safety gear, and asset financing.

groups.name: Entebbe Ghetto Women Association
groups.summary: Women-led community association of 23 members advancing female entrepreneurship, tailoring, food processing, and household financial resilience.
groups.projectDescription: Equips young women and mothers in Entebbe with commercial tailoring, catering, and retail trade capital backed by structured group bookkeeping.
groups.supportFocus: Sewing and processing machinery, business skills training, and women-led micro-grants.

groups.name: Entebbe GUDA Community SACCO
groups.summary: Community savings and credit cooperative uniting 57 members in Entebbe to build formal credit histories and enterprise working capital.
groups.projectDescription: Provides structured savings accounts and low-interest working capital loans to 57 local traders, fabricators, and service operators.
groups.supportFocus: SACCO capitalization, digital ledger administration, and commercial bank linkage.

groups.name: Entebbe Island Ghetto SACCO
groups.summary: High-membership community SACCO of 102 fisherfolk, boat artisans, fish processors, and lakeside traders in Entebbe Island.
groups.projectDescription: Mobilizes 102 lakeside workers to finance solar fish drying racks, cold-storage boxes, outboard engine maintenance, and safe marine transport.
groups.supportFocus: Solar cold-chain equipment, marine safety gear, and cooperative credit lines.

groups.name: Gaza Ghetto SACCO
groups.summary: Focused youth savings cooperative of 13 members in Entebbe building foundational capital discipline and formal trade identity.
groups.projectDescription: Enables 13 young urban workers to transition from daily casual labor into owned retail kiosks and mobile service units.
groups.supportFocus: Seed working capital, foundational bookkeeping, and vocational mentorship.

groups.name: Kinazi Ghetto Katabi Saving Association
groups.summary: Community savings association in Kinazi, Katabi Town Council with 58 active members engaged in construction, fabrication, and retail trade.
groups.projectDescription: Coordinates weekly savings collections and equipment-sharing pools for 58 youth and community entrepreneurs across Kinazi and Katabi.
groups.supportFocus: Briquette & construction tooling, financial literacy, and market linkage.

groups.name: Kitinda Cooperative Group
groups.summary: Multi-trade cooperative group in Kitinda, Nkumba organizing 57 members in urban agriculture, carpentry, masonry, and produce supply.
groups.projectDescription: Aggregates purchasing and production capacity for 57 cooperative members serving the Nkumba university and residential corridor.
groups.supportFocus: Carpentry & masonry equipment, bulk input financing, and cooperative governance.

groups.name: Lunyo East Ghetto Life Association
groups.summary: Large community youth association of 82 members in Lunyo East focused on livelihood skills, savings mobilization, and civic responsibility.
groups.projectName: Lunyo East Youth Skills & Enterprise Upgrading
groups.projectDescription: Supports 82 members in Lunyo East through structured apprenticeship placements, weekly savings circles, and group contract bidding.
groups.supportFocus: Technical skills training, group toolbanks, and institutional contract readiness.

groups.name: Peace Rock SACCO
groups.summary: Savings and credit cooperative of 28 members in Entebbe promoting disciplined member deposits and small-business growth.
groups.projectDescription: Provides reliable short-term inventory and equipment financing to 28 vetted members operating in Entebbe central markets.
groups.supportFocus: Revolving loan capital, digital record-keeping, and commercial banking integration.

groups.name: Twezimbe SACCO
groups.summary: Major community SACCO in Entebbe uniting 98 members across transport, market trade, and artisanal services under formal cooperative governance.
groups.projectDescription: Mobilizes savings from 98 active members to finance productive assets, wholesale market inventory, and emergency household resilience.
groups.supportFocus: Asset-finance co-funding, SACCO governance strengthening, and institutional partnerships.
